# Ready to quantify the shocking impact of friction on your site conversions?

See how Blue Triangle connects your website’s customer experience to conversion and revenue. In a personalized demo, explore how your team can estimate revenue opportunity, prioritize investigations and assess changes using your own measurement history.

#### Optimize Digital  Experiences

Learn how leading companies leverage Blue Triangle to support their business-critical culture of Continuous Experience Optimization.

![Group 21126](https://bluetriangle.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Blue_Triangle_June_2023/images/Group%2021126.png?width=70&height=70&name=Group%2021126.png)

#### Quantify  Website Friction

Discover how we help brands quantify the cost of website friction to prioritize and improve the digital customer experience in real time.

![Group 21126](https://bluetriangle.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Blue_Triangle_June_2023/images/Group%2021126.png?width=70&height=70&name=Group%2021126.png)

#### Utilize Actionable  Insights

Use experience, conversion and revenue measurements to decide what to investigate, prioritize improvements and assess the results.

![Group 21126](https://bluetriangle.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Blue_Triangle_June_2023/images/Group%2021126.png?width=70&height=70&name=Group%2021126.png)

#### Achieve Customer  Loyalty

Find out how we've turned impressive business performance into undying customer loyalty by adding business context to any observability stack.
